sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("HUD top-left 4x12:")
for r in range(4): print(a[r][0:12])
def find_player(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            if r1-r0>=4 and c1-c0>=4: return (r0,c0)
print("player now:",find_player(current_frame))
# test DOWN into white (1,1)
action(['DOWN'])
print("player after DOWN(left-mode, into white):",find_player(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
